question: What is an approximate single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 8%, 15% and 20%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**8% = 2/25, 15% = 3/20 and 20%= 1/5

Means, 2/25 = Discount/MP

3/20 = Discount/MP

1/5 = Discount/MP

SP = MP - Discount

 
 

 MP
 SP

 4
 
 

If we cut the common part and then multiply

MP = 625 (25 × 5 × 5)

SP = 391 (23 × 17)

Single discount = (625 - 391)\625 × 100 = **37%** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Approximate single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 8%, 15%, and 20%

Formula Used:

Single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of a % and b %

= (a + b - (a space × space b)/(100) ) %

**Calculation:**

Here, a = 8 % , and b = 15 %

So, the single discount = (8 + 15 - (8 space × space 15)/(100)) %

⇒ (23 - 1.2) %

⇒ 21.8 %

Again,

Here, a = 21.8 % , and b = 20 %

So, the single discount = (21.8 + 20 - (21.8 space × space 20)/(100)) %

⇒ (41.8 - 4.36) %

⇒ 37.44 % ≈ 37%

**The approximate single discount is 37%**
